about: Rivals the tower skips because their site is gone, parked or moved to another domain, or is a non-site (a tracker, sync, CDN or connectivity endpoint with nothing on its home page to use), each with the evidence of a real fetch (tools/tower-alive.mjs). Re-checked on every run.

unitingchurch.org.au.why: https://unitingchurch.org.au/ ends on controlhosting.net, not unitingchurch.org.au

id5-sync.com.why: https://id5-sync.com/ (200) shows 12 characters of text ("This is ID5."), 0 controls, 0 links, 0 forms and 51 bytes of page: an ad-tracking or sync endpoint, not a site a person uses; Verse lacks none of its features

oneyeard.com.why: https://oneyeard.com/ (200) answers an access-refusal stub ("Status Code: 403 OPPSSS!!!! Sorry... Sorry, your access is refused due to securi"): 0 usable controls and 227 characters of text — the page has been removed
